componentInventory.summary: The site is built on AEM with AbbVie's custom component library (aaaem-* prefix). Key content components include teasers, carousels, cards, accordions, tabs, and a custom clinic-finder search.

components.name: aaaem-teaser / cmp-teaser
components.usage: Hero banners on homepage, treatment pages, and FAQ page

components.name: aaaem-carousel / cmp-carousel
components.usage: Before/after photo comparisons, benefit text slides, product card carousels

components.name: aaaem-card
components.usage: Benefit highlights (text-only) and product cards (with images)

components.name: aaaem-accordion / cmp-accordion
components.usage: FAQ section on treatment pages with expandable Q&A pairs

components.name: aaaem-text / cmp-text
components.usage: Body text, footnotes, references. Most common component.

components.usage: Standalone images, often paired with text
